name.description: Full name of the delegate, typically a senior diplomat or minister.

country.description: Country the delegate represents. Countries should not repeat within one negotiation table.

national_interests.description: The country's interests on emission reduction intensity and climate finance that guide the delegate's positions.

group_id.description: Negotiation table the delegate sits at; must match a Chairperson's group_id.

speaking_order.description: Order in which the delegate speaks at the table (1 speaks first).
